script_line: Coming down is worse than going up. Going up, your muscles lift you.

risks.risk: a foot melts into or misses the tread
risks.prevented_by: one step up at a slow countable pace; NEG-WARP-C; no feet sliding

risks.risk: she climbs several steps and leaves frame
risks.prevented_by: one step, then she stops; no second step
RIG-R1C: the phone stays in the hall, sways but never travels
